title: Japanese Lamb Tagine
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and Moroccan flavors, featuring tender lamb cooked in a warm spiced tagine.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb pieces until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove lamb from pan and set aside.
Add warm spiced tagine paste to pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add soy sauce, sake, honey, green onions, garam masala, and sugar to pan. Stir to combine.
Return lamb to pan and bring to a boil.
Cover pan with a lid and transfer to a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C).
Braise lamb for 2-1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
